title: refactor: remove the retired permission-set catalog object's special cases; a Setup-created permission set is created live (objectui#7611)
body:
Part of #7611
Clause-②: no (narrowing)

Why `Part of` and not a closing line: the card's acceptance clause "under `isolated` a tenant admin ... can still assign" fails on objectstack `main` at the server (403 on the assignment write, reproduction below), and its producer is objectstack, so this card keeps that remainder. Items 1 and 4 are complete; item 2 was already done (objectui#12346).

## What this changes

**Item 1 — census row 8c, the retired catalog objects' object-page special cases and texts.** objectstack's ADR-0131 stage 8 retired `sys_position`, `sys_permission_set`, `sys_position_permission_set` and `sys_capability` (measured on objectstack `main` `6a49efb`: `GET /api/v1/meta/object/NAME` and `GET /api/v1/data/NAME` answer 404 for all four), and Setup's permission-set nav opens the registry-backed metadata page. Deleted as dead:
- `@object-ui/plugin-detail`: `PermissionFacetLink` and its `field:permission-facet-link` registration, with the special cases in `DetailSection` and `InlineFieldInput` (and their test cases);
- `@object-ui/data-objectstack`: the `getObjectSchema` widget stamp for the six `sys_permission_set` facets (`applyFieldWidgetOverrides`, whose only entry it was);
- `@object-ui/app-shell`: `RecordPermissionAssignmentsRenderer` and its `sys_permission_set` slot in `RecordDetailView` (the panel inside it, `AssignedUsersSection`, stays on the metadata page);
- `@object-ui/core`: `recordDelete`'s package-owned permission-set reset question and toast; `confirmText` now takes `{ t }`, and the injected data source needs only `delete`;
- `@object-ui/i18n`: `perm.facet.*` and `objectActions.resetPackageSet*` in all ten packs (the `perm-home-namespace-3546` test keeps its surviving `home` half);
- `@object-ui/cli`: `field:permission-facet-link` in the known schema types.

Re-worded where the text still has a live meaning: `@object-ui/types`' `idField` TSDoc and `content/docs/fields/lookup.mdx`, plugin-detail's `relationshipValueField` manifest description, the `MetadataFieldsPage` TSDoc, the `capabilityLint` docblock (no `sys_capability` seed source), the locale comments (deleted with their keys), ROADMAP, and comments that cited the deleted symbols.

**Item 3 gap, fixed here — a permission set created from the Setup catalog is created live** (`ResourceEditPage`, `registry.ts`, `anchors.ts`). Measured before the fix (objectstack `main`, `single`, a `manage_metadata` holder without `studio.access`): "New" wrote `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/qa_parity_set?mode=draft`; the set's editor (`PermissionMatrixEditPage`, the live environment door, which reads no draft) opened an empty set without the label; its Save wrote the grants live; Home then showed "1 unpublished change · QA Parity Set waiting to publish", and pressing Publish replaced the live grants with the empty create body (published item before: `objects.showcase_account` Read and Edit; after: `objects: {}`). The registry entry gains `createLive`, set on `permission`: outside a package binding the create writes live with the same first-write pin; under `?package=` it stays a package draft. Landing point: the producer of the draft, the generic create page, not the editor.

## Acceptance measurement (objectstack `main` `6a49efb`, console from this branch)

Rig: `objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p 4010` from `examples/app-showcase` (`Tenancy: single`); for `isolated`, the same app copied to a scratch directory whose `package.json` declares `@objectstack/organizations` (the CLI refuses a walled boot otherwise), with `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL` and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`. Console: `vite --port 5190` with `DEV_PROXY_TARGET`. Driven with Playwright (Chromium), network recorded.

Users under `single`: `author` = org admin (member role admin, `organization_admin_no_bypass`) plus a fixture set granting `manage_metadata`, `setup.access`, `setup.write` and **no `studio.access`** (`/auth/me/permissions` confirms); `orgadmin` = org admin only.

| Clause | Result | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Catalog pages render from the registry, four tables gone | PASS | Positions, Capabilities, Permission Sets pages list 17 / 12 / 21 items; their reads are `GET /api/v1/meta/position`, `/meta/capability`, `/meta/permission` (+ `/data/sys_metadata_activation`); the four objects answer 404 |
| No request fetches a merged list | PASS | No request to any retired object, and no list read besides the registry type read, in any recorded page load |
| Parity: create from the Setup page | PASS after this PR's fix | New, then Save: one `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/qa_parity_two` (no draft); the editor opens with the label; `GET /api/v1/meta/_drafts` answers `[]` |
| Parity: edit with the object x CRUD / field-level matrix | PASS | Read and Edit on `showcase_account`, field rows toggled; the published item carries `objects.showcase_account` and two `fields` entries |
| Parity: list views and filters | PASS | Search, source filter (Artifact 17 / Runtime 3), active filter (All / Active / Inactive) |
| Parity: deactivate and reactivate (active switch) | PASS | Two `POST /api/v1/security/_activation/permission/qa_parity_two`; the Inactive filter lists the set in between; the ledger row ends `active: true` |
| Parity: a managed set opens read-only with a clone action | PASS | `showcase_manager`: 749 of 749 matrix checkboxes disabled, "Clone to customize"; the clone dialog's `POST /api/v1/security/permission-sets/showcase_manager/clone` lands `qa_manager_copy` and opens it |
| Org admin without `manage_metadata` (ruling A on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22621) | PASS | No New button, switches disabled, editor read-only with "changing this item requires the `manage_metadata` capability" |
| Assign a declared and an environment-authored position through the picker; name-keyed row | PASS (platform admin) | Position page Add holder and the `sys_user_position` form (its Position select lists the 15 registry positions, the authored one included): rows with `position: manager` / `qa_env_position`; the authored position's set reaches the holder's effective sets |
| `isolated`: tenant admin sees the catalog read-only | PASS | Permission Sets and Positions: no New, "Read-only for organization administrators ..." |
| `isolated`: tenant admin can still assign | **FAIL — server** | Tenant admin (`organization_admin`): `POST /api/v1/data/sys_user_position` and `/data/sys_user_permission_set` answer `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`; the console correctly offers no Add holder. Producer: objectstack's `organization_admin` declaration keeps both assignment objects read-only ("Anti-escalation"), against ADR-0131 D3's "created and removed by that organization's admins". Not edited here; reported on the card |

Note on the parity gate's wording: the card body says "an organization administrator with **no** Studio capability". Maintainer ruling A on objectstack-ai/objectstack#22621 (record on the card, 6095024693) restated it: Setup authoring under `single` requires `manage_metadata`. The `author` user satisfies both: an org admin holding `manage_metadata` and no `studio.access`.

**Item 4 — objectui#7205.** Re-measured on the same rig as the platform admin: two header clicks on the `showcase_account` list re-sort it and send only `POST` / `PATCH /api/v1/data/sys_user_preference` (the user's own list preference, objectui#12418); zero writes to `/api/v1/meta/view`. Server-side, the per-organization overlay axis is retired (objectstack `meta-write-capability`: an organization admin's metadata write is refused like any caller without `manage_metadata`). Nothing of #7205 remains for this card.

## Tests and gates (head `a64d778`)

- Targeted vitest (repo root, `--maxWorkers=2`): 11 files / 206 tests, then 3 / 22, then 4 / 18 — all passed (the first run's one red file was a transform error this branch introduced and fixed in `a05e7a7`).
- New pin: `ResourceEditPage.liveCreate-7611.test.tsx`. Reverse-verified: with `createLive: false` its first case fails (the PUT carries `mode=draft`) while the package-binding control stays green; restored, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `pnpm turbo run type-check` over core, i18n, types, data-objectstack, fields (16 tasks) and plugin-detail, plugin-form, plugin-view, plugin-designer, app-shell, cli (35 tasks): all successful.
- ESLint on the changed files: no new errors (the 7 errors it prints are in untouched lines and are identical on `76f91f8`).
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: passes; `check-new-cross-file-line-citations`: 0 new.
- Full `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint` are CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- Observed, not filed: the read-only org-admin editor also shows "Read-only (this metadata type has no runtime write channel)" beside the correct capability reason.
- Observed, not filed: `approverIdentity`'s `DISPLAY_FIELDS_BY_OBJECT` still has a `sys_position` entry that no binding reaches since `position` binds to the registry; outside this card's file surface.
- `capabilityLint` assembles no `capabilities` (registry-declared) into its pseudo-stack; read only, not measured.
